# Grasshopper Fuels

> Grasshopper Fuels Limited supplies premium kiln-dried logs, coal, and kindling with free island-wide delivery across the Isle of Man.

Grasshopper Fuels is a solid fuel supplier based in Douglas, Isle of Man. We sell kiln-dried firewood (Birch, Oak, Ash), premium coal (Kosy Glo Ovoids), kindling nets, and firelighters, delivered free of charge to any address on the Isle of Man. Delivery only - we do not offer collection.

## Company

- Legal name: Grasshopper Fuels Limited
- Company number: 124767C (registered in the Isle of Man)
- Data protection registration: R901446 (Isle of Man Information Commissioner's Office)
- Website: https://www.grasshopperfuels.com
- Email: grasshopperfuels@outlook.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +44 7624 378119
- Address: Unit 3, Hills Meadow Industrial Estate, Douglas, IM1 5EA, Isle of Man

## Products and pricing (GBP, subject to change - see the live site for current prices and stock)

- Kiln-Dried Logs: Birch, Oak, and Ash, sold per net. Birch has a bulk discount for orders of 50+. See https://www.grasshopperfuels.com/products/kiln-dried-logs
- Coal: Premium Kosy Glo Ovoids, sold in 20kg bags. See https://www.grasshopperfuels.com/products/coal
- Kindling & Firelighters: 4kg Kindling Nets and boxes of natural firelighters. See https://www.grasshopperfuels.com/products/kindling

Live stock availability and exact current pricing: https://www.grasshopperfuels.com/order

## Delivery

Free, island-wide delivery across the Isle of Man on every order. Delivery only - no collection available. See https://www.grasshopperfuels.com/delivery

## Ordering and payment

Customers order online by adding priced items to a basket and checking out. Payment is taken online by card at checkout via Cashflows (a UK FCA-regulated payment provider). Items marked "Price on enquiry" are not available through instant checkout - contact us directly for those. See https://www.grasshopperfuels.com/order and https://www.grasshopperfuels.com/contact
